headword: {逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}

definitions.gloss: come-from-behind victory; a win after trailing
definitions.explanation: A victory achieved after being behind, in sport or in any contest. Standard sports-news vocabulary, usually with {飾|かざ}る (to cap off) or {収|おさ}める (to secure).

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}だった。
examples.english: It was a splendid come-from-behind victory.

examples.japanese: {九回|きゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三点|さんてん}⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: They scored three runs in the ninth inning and secured a comeback win.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{猛攻|もうこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: They could not score at all in the first half, but a fierce attack in the second half capped off a come-from-behind victory.

notes:
⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧ (reversal) + ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧ (victory). A compact compound of the kind sports headlines favor, alongside ⟦{逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け→逆転負け：16452_gyakutenmake⟧ (a loss after leading) and ⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧ (a go-ahead home run).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: to secure a comeback win
- {逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to cap things off with a comeback win
- ⟦{劇的|げきてき}→劇的：06830_gekiteki⟧な{逆転勝利|ぎゃくてんしょうり}: a dramatic comeback victory

USAGE:
Though it comes from sport, the word is also used of elections, court cases, and business competitions where a trailing side ends up winning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け→逆転負け：16452_gyakutenmake⟧: a come-from-ahead loss — the mirror image, seen from the losing side
- ⟦{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}→大逆転：21652_daigyakuten⟧: a great reversal — emphasizes the size of the turnaround, not the win itself
